items.distractor_fact: उसको छिमेकीसँग सोही दिन {D} रुपैयाँ थियो।
items.gloss_en: His neighbor had {D} rupees that same day.
items.entity_note: a different person (the neighbor), not the traveller whose balance the question asks about

items.distractor_fact: छिमेकीको बैंक खातामा सोही महिना {D} रुपैयाँ जम्मा थियो।
items.gloss_en: The neighbor's bank account had a balance of {D} rupees that same month.
items.entity_note: a different bank account belonging to a different person

items.distractor_fact: छिमेकी परिवारको आम्दानी सोही महिना {D} रुपैयाँ भयो।
items.gloss_en: The neighboring family's income was {D} rupees that same month.
items.entity_note: a different household than the one in the question

items.distractor_fact: अर्को टोलीले सोही सिजनमा {D} गोल गर्यो।
items.gloss_en: Another team scored {D} goals that same season.
items.entity_note: a different team than the one whose goal difference is asked about

items.distractor_fact: अर्को व्यापारीलाई सोही वर्ष {D} रुपैयाँ नाफा भयो।
items.gloss_en: Another trader had a profit of {D} rupees that same year.
items.entity_note: a different trader than the one in the question

items.distractor_fact: छिमेकी कारखानाले सोही महिना {D} टन उत्पादन गर्यो।
items.gloss_en: A neighboring factory produced {D} tons that same month.
items.entity_note: a different factory with its own unstated target, not the one being measured against its target

items.distractor_fact: सहरको अर्को पसलको बिक्री सोही महिना {D} रुपैयाँ भयो।
items.gloss_en: Another shop in the city had sales of {D} rupees that same month.
items.entity_note: a different shop with its own unstated sales target

items.distractor_fact: छिमेकी जिल्लामा सोही वर्ष {D} मिलिमिटर वर्षा भयो।
items.gloss_en: In the neighboring district, {D} millimeters of rain fell that same year.
items.entity_note: a different district with its own unstated forecast

items.distractor_fact: अर्को कोर्समा खेलेको खेलाडीले {D} स्ट्रोक खेल्यो।
items.gloss_en: A golfer playing on a different course took {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: a different course whose par is not the one stated in the story

items.distractor_fact: अर्को रेलमार्गको रेल मध्यरातदेखि {D} मिनेटपछि आइपुग्यो।
items.gloss_en: A train on another line arrived {D} minutes after midnight.
items.entity_note: a different train on a different line with its own unstated schedule

items.distractor_fact: छिमेकी भवनको एलिभेटर तल्ला {D} मा रोकियो।
items.gloss_en: The neighboring building's elevator stopped at floor {D}.
items.entity_note: a different building whose entrance floor is not the reference stated in the story

items.distractor_fact: छिमेकी तालको पानीको सतह सोही दिन {D} सेन्टिमिटरमा नापियो।
items.gloss_en: The neighboring lake's water level was measured at {D} centimeters that same day.
items.entity_note: a different lake with its own unstated reference mark

items.distractor_fact: उस्तै दिन खेलिएको अर्को खेलमा टोली गले {D} गोल गर्यो।
items.gloss_en: In another match played the same day, Team C scored {D} goals.
items.entity_note: a third team in an entirely different match, not टोली क or टोली ख

items.gloss_en: Student C got {D} marks in the exam.
items.entity_note: a third student, not विद्यार्थी क or विद्यार्थी ख

items.distractor_fact: एकै समयमा सहर गको तापक्रम {D}°C थियो।
items.gloss_en: At the same time, City C's temperature was {D}°C.
items.entity_note: a third city, not सहर क or सहर ख
